T: Spirits in the house. Steak on the bench.
D: A suburban family's house is invaded by spirits who take their youngest daughter.
P: Serve the steak when one crawls across the kitchen bench.
S: Buttered popcorn, pepper and sesame static. They're here.
Popcorn tossed in melted butter with fine salt, cracked black pepper and black sesame so it looks like static.
Thick cheese slices stacked with crackers between each layer
Thick slices of cheddar, gouda and Swiss stacked in a crooked tower with crackers between each layer, skewered through the middle.
round crackers with cream cheese, salami, cherry tomato nose and olive eyes, grilled until melting

Round crackers loaded with cream cheese, salami, a cherry tomato nose and olive eyes, flashed under the grill so the cheese just melts. Mix 150g cream cheese with 50g grated mozzarella and a pinch of oregano. Spread onto 20 round crackers on a tray. Give each a thin round of salami from 100g as a face, half a cherry tomato for a nose, two slices of black olive for eyes and a strip of red capsicum for a grin. Grill for 2 minutes until the cheese is just melting and serve straight away.
M: Seared rump steaks basted in garlic butter, with baked potatoes
Rump steaks seasoned, seared hard in a smoking pan, butter, garlic and thyme basted in, pulled at 54C, rested 5 minutes. Jacket potatoes and creamed spinach.
a suburban weeknight dinner in the new estate

Pasta shells, tuna and peas folded through a sharp cheddar white sauce, topped with buttery breadcrumbs and baked until bubbling and golden. Boil 400g pasta shells for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain. Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, then whisk in 700ml milk and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and pepper. Fold through the pasta with 2 x 185g tins drained tuna and 200g frozen peas. Tip into a baking dish, top with 60g breadcrumbs mixed with 20g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: Crisp white meringue. This house is clean.
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff peaks, piped into tall ghostly drops, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven.
K: Orange soda poured over vanilla ice cream
Orange soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up creamy and orange. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each of 4 glasses and pour over 300ml cold orange soda slowly so it foams.

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Peel the celeriac, cut into 4 slices about 3cm thick and season with salt.
Sear in the oil in a hot pan, then lower the heat, add the butter, crushed garlic and thyme, and baste, turning, until tender all the way through.
Rest for 3 minutes.
Wilt the spinach with the cream and serve alongside the steaks and potatoes.

s.note: Buttered popcorn, pepper and sesame static. They're here.
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss with 50g melted butter, fine salt, 1 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tbsp black sesame seeds until it looks like TV static. Serve in a bowl in front of the screen.

s.note: Thick cheese slices stacked with crackers between each layer
s.how: Slice 150g cheddar, 150g gouda and 150g Swiss thickly. Stack in crooked towers with a cracker between each layer and push a long skewer through the middle to hold them. Make four towers.

m.note: Seared rump steaks basted in garlic butter, with baked potatoes
m.how: Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 70 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks (about 250g each) and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, adding 40g butter, garlic and thyme to baste, and pull at 54C inside. Rest 5 minutes. Wilt 300g spinach with 125ml cream and serve alongside.

w.note: Crisp white meringue. This house is clean.
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add 180g caster sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall drops and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.

d.note: Orange soda poured over vanilla ice cream
d.how: Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each of 4 glasses and pour over 300ml cold orange soda slowly so it foams. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
